items.stem: Which command displays the amount of free and used disk space on mounted filesystems?

options.rationale: Correct: df reports filesystem disk space usage.
du estimates file and directory space usage, not free space per filesystem.
ps reports running processes, not disk space.
top shows process and system activity, not filesystem free space.

items.explanation: Correct: df reports filesystem disk space usage.

items.stem: In a shell pipeline, what does the pipe symbol ( | ) do?

options.text: Sends the standard output of one command as the standard input of the next
options.rationale: Correct: a pipe connects one command's stdout to the next command's stdin.

options.text: Runs two commands at the same time with no connection
options.rationale: That describes backgrounding with &, not a pipe.
Redirecting to a file uses > or >>, not a pipe.

options.text: Comments out the rest of the line
options.rationale: Comments use #, not the pipe symbol.

items.explanation: Correct: a pipe connects one command's stdout to the next command's stdin.
